title: Map an entity-returning controller onto a record DTO
summary: GET /users fails on a lazy collection and was leaking passwordHash, so it returns a record instead.

turns.user: turned off open-in-view and now GET /users is a 500. failed to lazily initialize a collection of role: com.example.user.User.orders ... no Session. also just noticed the old response had passwordHash in it. yikes

assistant.body: Great catch on the password. Both problems have one cause: the controller returns the entity itself, so Jackson calls every getter it can find. That includes getOrders(), a lazy collection, and with open-in-view off the session is already closed by then. Every field with a getter also ends up in the JSON, passwordHash included. A record holding only the fields the API should expose fixes both, and keeps the shape of the API separate from the shape of the table.

turns.user: fixed. frontend wants the created date too. key should be created_at

assistant.body: Note: a record component name becomes the JSON key as it stands, so createdAt gets @JsonProperty to come out as created_at. Switching the whole ObjectMapper to snake_case would rename keys in every other endpoint too, so this stays on the one field.
